greeting: Ven on comms. Stage 3: Heart of the Blight. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Sinking Truth. Objective drift gets teams buried.
The compass spun, laughed, and still pointed exactly where we needed to go.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Navigate the Deep Mire.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Navigate the Deep Mire; Breach the Sunken Temple; Identify the corruption source. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Investigate the source of corruption at the sunken temple. Immediate move: Navigate the Deep Mire.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: Heart of the Blight. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Venom's Truth.
rumor: Boardwalk crews say the swamp now mirrors stars from the wrong season.
People keep repeating one clue from Heart of the Blight: 'Identify the corruption source'.
I catalog omens by flavor now. Today tastes like burnt citrus and bad decisions.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn mist sits low in the Mire; good for stealth, bad for footing.
dialog.time_noon: Noon stirs the boardwalk gases. Keep sparks and spells controlled.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk wakes the sink patches. Test every plank before weight transfer.
dialog.time_night: Night in swamp country means sound carries wrong. Use lantern codes.

party_reactions.kade: Ven sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Ven accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Ven talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: If the world bends, we bend it back together.
